scripts.build:shared: npm run build --workspace @my-code-x/contracts && npm run build --workspace @my-code-x/utils
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run typecheck:backend
scripts.typecheck:full: npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run typecheck:backend:full
scripts.start:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace apps/server && npm run start --workspace apps/server
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace apps/web
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace apps/server
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/web && npm run lint --workspace apps/server && eslint .
scripts.test:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace apps/web
scripts.test:root: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @my-code-x/utils && node --test --test-reporter=dot scripts/my-code-x-user-env.test.mjs scripts/my-code-x-user-harness.test.mjs scripts/my-code-x-launcher.unit.test.mjs scripts/my-code-x-supervisor-config.test.mjs scripts/launcher/launcher-owned-processes.test.mjs scripts/tailscale-serve.test.mjs scripts/tailscale-bootstrap.test.mjs scripts/codex-upstream-compat.test.mjs scripts/shared/smoke-probes.test.mjs scripts/release/build-release.test.mjs scripts/screenshot/screenshot-mobile-cli.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:root
scripts.build:new: npm run build:contracts-new && npm run build:server-new && npm run build:web-new
scripts.typecheck:new: npm run typecheck:contracts-new && npm run typecheck:server-new && npm run typecheck:web-new
scripts.test:new: npm run test:contracts-new && npm run test:server-new && npm run test:web-new
scripts.lint:new: npm run lint:contracts-new && npm run lint:server-new && npm run lint:web-new
